title: Enterprise UI/UX
description: A ground-up redesign of the authenticated Enterprise UI/UX: an icon rail for Network, Engage, Sales, Finance, Operations and Support with an Enterprise brand square for cross-cutting views, beside a menu panel for the active module, built by nesting Sidebar parts; the inset sidebar variant can be toggled from the control panel. Each module's root route is a dashboard for that module; menu items open placeholder list views. The rail's icons are chosen from the control panel (Cmd/Ctrl+K).

changelog.changes: Add the Operations module, make Enterprise a cross-cutting module with its own menu, give every module a dashboard as its root view, re-plan the module menus from the beacon-enterprise duplication audit, add an inset toggle to the control panel, and split the recipe into a folder, add an Overview control (overview as a menu row, or the panel header as the link), and show only a tooltip on the active module's rail button while the panel is open.
